title: webhook://
description:
`webhook://`: an HTTP endpoint described by OpenAPI 3.1; every accepted request is an
item. See `:help dbdash-webhook` and the curl commands in the file.

query.transform:
-- rs: one item; params: { path, query, header, cookie }; request: method, path,
-- operation_id, content_type, headers (without credentials).
store.events = store.events or {}
local what
if request.operation_id == "ping" then
  what = ("ping n=%d tags=%s"):format(rs.n, table.concat(rs.tags or {}, "+"))
elseif request.operation_id == "logs" then
  what = rs
else
  what = ("%s %s%s"):format(rs.user, rs.action, rs.amount and (" " .. rs.amount) or "")
end
local from = params.path.source or request.operation_id
local region = params.cookie.region or ""
table.insert(store.events, 1, { os.date("%H:%M:%S"), from, region, what })
while #store.events > 12 do table.remove(store.events) end
return { columns = { "at", "from", "region", "event" }, rows = store.events }

show.title: Events pushed over HTTP
show.description:
The events posted to the endpoints (see the curl commands at the top of the file):
parameters, bodies and the operation of each request, the newest first.
